top_signals.title: Healey: We don’t have as much money as we did under New Labour
top_signals.summary: Chancellor John Healey has warned Labour members that the government does not have available funds to spend more on public services.  In his address to party activists, Healey said Tony Blair’s government in the late 1990s and early 2000s had more flexibility with public finances given higher growth rates and lower amounts of debt.  The [...]

top_signals.title: India State Firms Pull $688 Million of Bond Sales as Yields Rise
top_signals.summary: Two state-run Indian companies have withdrawn plans to raise $688 million through rupee bonds as an expected interest-rate increase and the central bank’s move to drain surplus cash drive borrowing costs higher.
